newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Suedelektra says CCH to build two furnaces.
newsitem.headline: Suedelektra says CCH to build two furnaces.

text.p: Suedelektra Holding AG said its board had approved the construction by Chromecorp Holdings Ltd (CCH) of two additional furnaces at its facility at Wonderkop, South Africa for around 173 million rand.
The two furnaces will have a combined capacity of 160,000 metric tonnes, Suedelektra said in a statement.
The investment will be financed by CCH's operating cash flow and the new furnaces are expected to be in production during the fourth quarter of 1997.
The furnaces will increase CCH's annual production capacity to 600,000 tonnes of ferrochrome.

The statement added that CCH's relationship with commodities trading firm Glencore International AG has enabled it to secure additional ferrochrome sales, allowing it to commit to the additional production capacity.
